model_missing.this_computer: The local model {{model}} is not available on this computer yet.
model_missing.container: The local model {{model}} is not available in the local model container yet.
model_missing.remote: The local model {{model}} is not available on the model server {{host}} yet.
model_missing.server: The local model {{model}} is not installed on this Nodestro server.

runtime_missing.this_computer: Local models need the local model runtime (Ollama), which is not installed on this computer yet. Nodestro can set it up for you; after that, {{model}} can be downloaded.

server_stopped.this_computer: The local model server on this computer could not be started, so Nodestro cannot check or use {{model}}.

server_unreachable.this_computer: The Ollama server you configured does not answer, so Nodestro cannot check or use {{model}}.
server_unreachable.container: The local model container does not answer. Check that Nodestro Local Docker is running completely.
server_unreachable.remote: The model server {{host}} does not answer, so Nodestro cannot check or use {{model}}.
server_unreachable.server: The model server of this Nodestro server does not answer. Your administrator can check it.

server_missing.this_computer: No local model server is configured here, so {{model}} cannot run.
server_missing.server: This Nodestro server has no local model server. Your administrator can configure one.

model_name_invalid.this_computer: “{{model}}” is not the name of a model that runs locally (an invalid name, or an Ollama cloud model). Check the model in the configuration.

disk_full.this_computer: {{model}} needs about {{size}}, but only {{free}} are free in the model folder. Free up space, or move the model folder to a larger drive in the settings.
disk_full.container: {{model}} needs about {{size}}, but only {{free}} are free in the container’s model folder. Free up space on the drive, then check again.

capability_missing.this_computer: {{model}} is installed, but it does not support what this step needs: {{list}}.
capability_missing.registry: {{model}} does not support what this step needs: {{list}}. Its entry in the model registry says so, so it was not downloaded.

hardware_insufficient.this_computer: {{model}} is not installed, and it probably needs more memory than this computer has.
hardware_insufficient.container: {{model}} is not installed, and it probably needs more memory than this computer gives the container.

facts.sizeUnknown: The download size is not known in advance.
facts.free: Free space in the model folder: {{free}}
facts.memory: Needs about {{memory}} of memory to run
facts.partial: Already downloaded: {{size}}. The download continues there.
facts.fitsNo: This computer may not have enough memory for this model. It can run very slowly or not at all; a smaller model is usually the better choice.

blocked.permission: You do not have permission to install models here. Ask an administrator to install {{model}}.
blocked.operator: Models on this Nodestro server are installed by its operator, not on your computer. Ask your administrator to install {{model}} on the server.
blocked.offline: The strict offline mode is on, so nothing is downloaded. Import the model from a file in the settings, or choose another model.

why.architect: The Workflow Architect uses this model to design your workflow.
why.assistant: The assistant uses this model to answer your message.
why.agent_design: Nodestro uses this model to design what you asked for.
why.agent_test: The agent uses this model for the test.
why.run: An agent of this workflow uses this model.
why.knowledge_index: The knowledge search uses this model to build the semantic index.
why.check: This workflow or task needs this model.

keep.architect: Your name, description and options are kept. The Workflow Architect starts with them as soon as the model is ready.
keep.assistant: Your message and its files stay in the input field. They are sent as soon as the model is ready.
keep.agent_design: Your description is kept. Nodestro continues with it as soon as the model is ready.
keep.agent_test: Your test input is kept. The test runs as soon as the model is ready.
keep.run: Your run inputs are kept. The run starts as soon as the model is ready.
keep.knowledge_index: The semantic index is built as soon as the model is ready.
keep.check: After the download, start the action again.

capability.completion: answering with text (it is an embedding model)
capability.embedding: embeddings for the knowledge search (it is a chat model)

choose.title: Models that are ready now
choose.note: The chosen model is used for this action only. Your settings are not changed.
choose.noteAgent: The chosen model is used for this test only. The saved agent keeps its model.
choose.limited: Its maximum output is smaller than this step asks for, so the output limit is lowered.

job.already: This model is already being downloaded. Its progress is shown here; no second download is started.
job.background: You can close this dialog: the download continues in the background (Settings, Local models).
job.auto: Continue automatically when the model is ready
job.autoHint: Nodestro will {{action}} once, with what you entered, as soon as the model has been checked.

ready.title: The model is ready
ready.text: {{model}} is installed and was checked. Continue to {{action}}.
ready.fix: {{model}} is installed and was checked. Start the action again when you are ready.
